outcome: Adult intensive care unit (ICU) admission rate
Severe maternal morbidity associated with postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: Active duty service members and their families who gave birth at participating military treatment facilities in the Department of Defense
finding: Despite equal access to healthcare and similar socioeconomic statuses in the military healthcare system, Black women experienced higher rates of cesarean deliveries, ICU admissions, and overall severe maternal morbidity compared to White women.
